markets.title: Dulmar Suuqa
markets.intro1: Ka hel dulmar dhammeystiran dhammaan cryptocurrencies-ka OMAYA Express. Boggan waxa uu soo bandhigayaa qiimayaasha ugu dambeeyay, mugga ganacsiga 24-saac, isbeddelada qiimaha, iyo qiimaha suuqa ee dhammaan cryptocurrencies-ka caalamka.
markets.intro2: Isticmaalayaashu si fudud ayay u heli karaan faahfaahinta muhiimka ah ee hantidan dijitaalka ah waxayna si toos ah uga gudbi karaan madasha ganacsiga.
markets.noFavorites: Hanti la jecel yahay lama helin. Ku dar si aad halkan ugu aragto.
